reports.health_check:
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-generated health check for person-events
# Generated: now

echo "🔍 Running pre-flight health checks for person-events..."


if [ ! -f "package.json" ]; then
    echo "❌ Missing required file: package.json"
    exit 1
fi


if ! cat package.json | head -1 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "❌ package.json is not valid"
    exit 1
fi


# Check if port is already in use
if command -v lsof > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    if lsof -Pi :6000 -sTCP:LISTEN -t >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "⚠️  Port 6000 is already in use"
    fi
fi


echo "✅ All health checks passed for person-events"
